questions.question: Figma MCP access is blocked (permission not granted) and the budget is ~$1.16 of $2 remaining. How should I proceed?

options.label: Grant Figma + extract
options.description: You approve the figma MCP tools (get_metadata/get_design_context/get_variable_defs) so I can pull measured bounds/tokens/styles for the checkout + home frozen frames and write real specs. Costs budget per call.

options.label: Blocked-mode artifacts
options.description: I skip Figma calls, write OPUS-DESIGN-AUTHORITY.md + component-mapping + asset-manifest enrichment from source code & the frozen source map, and deliver spec files as blocker-flagged stubs (NOT fabricated measurements). Honest, cheap, no fidelity claim.

options.label: Stop now
options.description: Budget is too tight; stop and report the blocker + exact next steps without producing partial artifacts.

tool_input.command: echo "=== component/function decls ===" && grep -nE "^(function|const) [A-Z][A-Za-z]+|^const [a-zA-Z]+ = \(\{|=> \{$" App.tsx | grep -iE "function|=>" | grep -E "[A-Z]" | head -60 && echo "=== RouteKey + routes ===" && grep -nE "RouteKey|'/[a-z]|appHome|'checkout'|'detail'|'insights'|'purchases'|'dues'" App.tsx | head -30
